turn_prompts: Write clear solver-facing task instructions from the approved generated task files. State the expected behavior, constraints, local verification steps, and non-goals without revealing solution-only reasoning. When invoking the stage-private harbor_submit_stage_output dynamic tool, set the sole artifact content_base64 to the standard base64 encoding of the final instruction.md bytes themselves. The decoded payload must be raw Markdown, not a JSON object, format/version envelope, content field, artifact-name field, Markdown code fence, or explanatory wrapper. Do not finish with prose alone; only an accepted tool submission is a stage result.
